formula: min(cap, coefficient * max(0, (player hits/game minus positional mean) / positional population standard deviation))
capAppliedPolicy: True only when the uncapped bonus exceeds the cap.
missingDataPolicy: Below-cutoff bonuses remain unavailable. Eligible average/below-average hitting earns zero. Invalid eligible scoring inputs fail the run.
note: Provisional auxiliary bonus amounts, not direct additions to a 0–10 grade. No overall contribution, historical aggregation or standalone grade assigned.
